name: Withings MCP Client
description: Enables retrieval of health data from Withings smart scales including weight measurements and comprehensive body composition metrics like fat mass, muscle mass, and hydration levels. Supports multiple users, unit preferences, and OAuth authentication for secure access to personal health data.
